name: Hardcoded Secret / API Key
description: Hardcoded credentials detected in source code.
remediation: Store credentials in environment variables or a secret manager.

name: Command Injection Risk
description: Executing commands via shell=True risks system compromise.
remediation: Avoid shell=True and pass arguments as a structured list.

name: SQL Injection Risk
description: Unsanitized string formatting detected inside SQL query.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM.

name: Insecure Deserialization
description: Deserializing untrusted data can lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE).
remediation: Use safe_load for YAML or safer serialization formats like JSON.
